data.long_meaning: The name Sharline has no direct biblical or historical meaning. It is a modern name derived from the English word 'shar' meaning pure, clear, or bright, and the suffix 'line' which means strong or little one. The name Sharline carries the meaning “Pure, Clear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sharline usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
